title: Text: DET Chad Crunk ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: If he gets in, what time do you think we’ll get him?
The HOF will have a conference call for him at 7, probably after that. Will try to get you a more definitive time later this afternoon

FYI, I know you guys put Alcantara on waivers but Al thinks he might pass so I told him I wouldn’t put it out there. If you could give me a half hour heads up before you guys announce it tomorrow, would be sweet
Ok will try to do that
